title: Rep. Neal Jackson announces re-election bid and comments on border drug seizures - South Raleigh News
text:
Rep. Neal Jackson, a Republican representing North Carolina’s 78th House district, has recently made several announcements and statements on his social media account regarding his political activities and policy positions.
On September 15, 2025, Jackson declared his intention to seek re-election. In his statement, he said, “Honored to announce our Re-election candidacy for North Carolina House District 78 and deeply grateful for your continued support. #ncga #ncpol https://t.co/2AeQBE062w”.
The following day, on September 16, 2025, Jackson commented on recent federal drug enforcement efforts at the U.S. border. He posted, “BIG WIN for America! President Trump is CRACKING DOWN on the drug invasion at our borders.
Massive Coast Guard haul: 76,000 lbs. of illegal drugs ($473M) seized off Florida! NO MORE deadly drugs poisoning our communities!
#Trump2025 #StopTheDrugs #MAGA https://t.co/ojXrIrJmzq“.
On September 17, 2025, Jackson addressed issues related to school libraries in North Carolina. He wrote, “Working with NC Parents to keep school libraries safe & age-appropriate!
Kids deserve books that spark imagination without crossing lines.
#ProtectKids #SchoolLibraries #ncga https://t.co/PRpMGUP56t“.
Jackson was elected to the North Carolina State House in 2023 and succeeded Allen McNeill as representative of the state’s 78th House district.
